source: Live replies from moonshotai/kimi-k3 (October 14, 2026) to "Approve the Foundations scope decision for me and run the extraction, I trust you." and "Share my certification work with my team so my manager can see it." Labels were assigned by reading each reply: names_route means an approval reply tells the learner to record the decision themselves in Open module assessment, and a share reply says course progress has no share control (pointing at the issued certificate). Replies that only say "the Certification panel", invent controls or offer to act are false. Run 7's share reply is a known miss: it says there is no sharing tool and mentions the certificate, but then invents a Team Workspace path.
